alt: A grand double-height entrance hall with a central sweeping staircase, shown in six design styles: Art Deco with emerald velvet and brass, Moroccan with carved plaster and zellige tile, Industrial with exposed brick and steel, Japanese Zen with pale ash wood, Gothic Romantic with deep jewel tones and carved walnut, and Neoclassical Regency with warm damask and gold.
text:
same staircase, six materials.

the architecture holds still. everything else shifts: emerald and brass. carved plaster. exposed brick. pale ash. indigo tile. damask.

one staircase becomes six completely different rooms. the material is the whole story.
